'''Hamad''' is a [[Saldaean]] under the command of [[Davram Bashere]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a dark beard and mustache with green tilted eyes. He has a scar down his face.

== Activities ==
While in [[Caemlyn]] he brings in a messenger from [[Sammael]] to [[Rand al'Thor]].

He is one of the Saldaeans to accompany Bashere and Rand to Rand's meeting with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]. During this meeting it is revealed that the supposed Daughter of the Nine Moons is actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise. After a fight insues, he is asked to secure the area by Bashere.
